<title level="2" right="Creature 16">[Trexima Butoi](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2561)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="NE" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Undead" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=160" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 28

**Perception** +26; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Daemonic](/Languages.aspx?ID=31), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Mwangi](/Languages.aspx?ID=39), [Necril](/Languages.aspx?ID=20), [Osiriani](/Languages.aspx?ID=40), [Undercommon](/Languages.aspx?ID=11)

**Skills**
[Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +31, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +29, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +29, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +27, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +27, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +27

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +0

**Dex** +5

**Con** +4

**Int** +7

**Wis** +5

**Cha** +5
</row>

**Items**
_[greater staff of necromancy](/Equipment.aspx?ID=360)_, _[The Tangled Briar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2515)_, _wand of [_necrotize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=956)_ (7th level)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 37 

**Fort** +25 

**Ref** +28 

**Will** +30 

+1 status to all saves vs. [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 290
([negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42), rejuvenation)

</row>

**Immunities**
[death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38)

**Resistances**
[cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) 15, physical 15 (except [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=103) bludgeoning)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_staff_ +23 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [two-hand d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=198)),
**Damage** 1d4+6 bludgeoning

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
hand +30 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 5d8 negative plus [paralyzing touch](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=68)

**Arcane Prepared Spells** DC 37, attack +29
- **Cantrips (8th)**
[Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Mage Hand](/Spells.aspx?ID=177), [Message](/Spells.aspx?ID=190), [Ray of Frost](/Spells.aspx?ID=245), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280)
- **1st**
[Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110), [Fleet Step](/Spells.aspx?ID=122), [Ray of Enfeeblement](/Spells.aspx?ID=244)
- **2nd**
[Mirror Image](/Spells.aspx?ID=197), [Resist Energy](/Spells.aspx?ID=256), [See Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=271)
- **3rd**
[Magic Missile](/Spells.aspx?ID=180), [Paralyze](/Spells.aspx?ID=213), [Stinking Cloud](/Spells.aspx?ID=309)
- **4th**
[Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) (×2), [Freedom of Movement](/Spells.aspx?ID=128)
- **5th**
[Grim Tendrils](/Spells.aspx?ID=141), [Illusory Object](/Spells.aspx?ID=160), [Wall of Ice](/Spells.aspx?ID=364)
- **6th**
[Cloudkill](/Spells.aspx?ID=42), [Mislead](/Spells.aspx?ID=199), [Purple Worm Sting](/Spells.aspx?ID=242)
- **7th**
[Eclipse Burst](/Spells.aspx?ID=96), [Fly](/Spells.aspx?ID=125), [Spell Turning](/Spells.aspx?ID=297)
- **8th**
[Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Horrid Wilting](/Spells.aspx?ID=152), [Polar Ray](/Spells.aspx?ID=224)

**Rituals** 

- **2nd**
[Create Undead](/Rituals.aspx?ID=10)

**Drain Soul Cage** <actions string="Free Action" />  Frequency once per day; Effect The lich taps into its _soul cage's_ power to cast any arcane spell up to the highest level the lich can cast, even if the spell being cast is not one of the lich's prepared spells. The lich's _soul cage_ doesn't need to be present for the lich to use this ability.

**Siphon Life** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([Necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117)) **Trigger** Trexima deals damage with his hand Strike; **Effect** Trexima regains Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

**Steady Spellcasting**   If a reaction would disrupt Trexima's spellcasting action, he attempts a DC 15 flat check. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

</column>
name: Trexima Butoi
